summary.intent: Wire CTR encryption mode into the SDK's uploadFile() so large media files use AES-CTR instead of hardcoded AES-GCM, enabling the streaming playback pipeline.
summary.outcome: CTR encryption is now selected automatically for media files >256KB in the SDK client, passed through to sdk-core and file metadata, E2E streaming playback tests pass including the previously-skipped CTR badge test, and a PR was opened.

repo: selectEncryptionMode() logic lived only in streaming-crypto.service.ts (web app) and was never called for new SDK uploads — the CTR path only triggered on the duplicate-file re-encrypt path.
sdk-core typecheck errors during development were often caused by stale build output; rebuilding sdk-core first resolves downstream SDK type errors.
The web E2E tests run against live local dev servers (API on one port, Vite on another); rebuilding packages is sufficient for HMR pickup before running Playwright.

Pre-existing test failures in sdk-core/__tests__ were due to DTO shape drift: PublishIpnsResponseDto lost its cid field, ResolveIpnsResponseDto lost source, and IpfsAddResult gained size and recorded fields.

code.finding: uploadFile() hardcoded encryptAesGcm and encryptionMode: 'GCM'; needed an optional encryptionMode param to branch into CTR path with encryptAesCtr + generateCtrIv.
Client's uploadFile() was the right place to call selectEncryptionMode() using mimeType + size, then pass the result down to sdkCore.uploadFile().
Reference implementation for MIME type list and 256KB threshold used in selectEncryptionMode(); duplicated into sdk/client.ts.
CTR encrypted badge test was skipped pending this fix; removing test.skip was part of the todo's acceptance criteria.
Mock objects were out of sync with current DTO shapes; PublishIpnsResponseDto and ResolveIpnsResponseDto fields had changed without test updates.
addToIpfs mock was returning { cid } but IpfsAddResult type requires { cid, size, recorded }.

workflow: Build sdk-core before typechecking sdk when sdk-core types have changed — the SDK imports compiled output, not source.
When running E2E tests against local dev, rebuild packages first; Vite HMR picks up workspace package changes without restarting.
GSD todo workflow: moving a todo to done/ and committing signals intent; the commit is bundled with the implementation changes at PR time.

friction: sdk-core build output was stale, causing misleading type errors in the SDK typecheck step — required an extra build step mid-implementation.
Pre-existing test failures in sdk-core (DTO shape drift) were unrelated to the feature but had to be fixed before typecheck was clean.
selectEncryptionMode() logic had to be duplicated from streaming-crypto.service.ts into sdk/client.ts — no shared utility existed.
open_items: selectEncryptionMode() is now duplicated between streaming-crypto.service.ts and sdk/client.ts — should be extracted to a shared crypto utility package.
13 other pending todos remain, including BYO-IPFS register-cid 400 errors on staging (api, 9h ago) which may be urgent.
The streaming-playback E2E suite only runs against local dev; no CI coverage confirmed for CTR path end-to-end.
